conclusion: At upstream 0acf1e6680, Classic and Arachne respect wall sequence/direction on thin and narrow tube walls, including shared odd centre lines. Inner/Outer/Inner has no third wall to sandwich on a narrow hole: print the hole, contour and shared middle/gap fill in the tested order. Positive-width explicit outer, outer-and-inner and belt leading-edge brims force outer walls first on layer zero; auto/ear/painted brims do not. Invalidate perimeters when brim_type or brim_width changes that outer-first decision. Preserve the belt leading-edge case when porting the common helper. The seven imported behavioral fixtures and existing belt/support fixtures passed on Windows. This is a version-bound source/fixture contract, not a GUI or cross-platform claim.
